decision_blocked_until: Static source includes storage-cleaning and export-related functions, but the wrapper alters visible controls; source alone cannot decide the complete UI claim.
missing_precedence_or_reachability_proof: The final effective DOM after wrapper suppression and runtime injections has not been observed.
preserved_claim: Data minimization, user consent, retention display, export, and deletion controls are not implemented in the UI.
reopening_trigger: Any base-app control, wrapper suppression rule, injected script, route, or browser behavior changes.
required_environment_and_configuration: Local HTTPS server in a standards browser after pressing Open Latest App.
runtime_behavior_to_test: Whether minimization, consent, retention display, export, and deletion controls are simultaneously present and usable.
smallest_test_or_receipt: Open the current door, press Open Latest App, capture the final DOM and exercise each named control with a redacted receipt.

decision_blocked_until: The effective runtime cannot prove completeness of records that are not runtime-reachable.
missing_precedence_or_reachability_proof: A complete authoritative packet-by-packet output inventory is outside the runtime chain and has not been bound to every packet identifier.
preserved_claim: No full output inventory proves which required human and machine records exist for every packet.
reopening_trigger: Packet inventory requirements, packet identifiers, expected artifacts, or repository contents change.
required_environment_and_configuration: Authoritative main repository plus approved packet index.
runtime_behavior_to_test: Whether every required human and machine record exists for every packet.
runtime_source_path: Effective runtime chain and packet-output surfaces reachable from it
smallest_test_or_receipt: Generate a digest-bound expected-versus-present inventory for every packet and independently verify completeness.

decision_blocked_until: Runtime source proves only the current code path, not every historical or external state.
missing_precedence_or_reachability_proof: The freeze scope for historical, external, private, device, and provider state is not directly controlled by the runtime route.
preserved_claim: The current freeze covers only the proven current app/source/control path, not every historical or external state.
reopening_trigger: Freeze scope, external state, private evidence, provider state, device state, or governing receipt changes.
required_environment_and_configuration: Authoritative main plus approved external/private evidence boundary.
runtime_behavior_to_test: Whether the freeze covers every state named by the preserved claim.
runtime_source_path: Current runtime graph and existing freeze receipts
smallest_test_or_receipt: Produce a scope matrix covering current, historical, external, private, device, and provider state and verify each frozen or explicitly excluded cell.

decision_blocked_until: Runtime reachability alone cannot prove the product scope decision or its acceptance boundary.
missing_precedence_or_reachability_proof: No approved first-release/MVP scope record is directly controlling the runtime graph.
preserved_claim: The system’s first release scope and minimum viable safe capability are not frozen, increasing risk of building all 30 modules at once.
reopening_trigger: Release scope, reachable modules, feature flags, or approval changes.
required_environment_and_configuration: Authoritative main plus approved release-scope decision.
runtime_behavior_to_test: Whether a bounded safe first release is frozen instead of implicitly exposing the wider module set.
runtime_source_path: pmp-current-map-v9.json and current runtime module surfaces
smallest_test_or_receipt: Bind a release-scope manifest to exact reachable modules and verify that non-MVP modules are disabled or absent.

decision_blocked_until: Source establishes intended routing but not installed-device cache behavior.
missing_precedence_or_reachability_proof: Physical Home Screen installation, cache, relaunch, and update behavior is not repository-provable.
preserved_claim: Installed iPhone Home Screen runtime and cache behavior have not been tested.
reopening_trigger: Device, iOS/WebKit version, route, cache key, serving headers, or test result changes.
required_environment_and_configuration: Supported physical iPhone, exact iOS and Safari/WebKit version, Home Screen installed mode.
runtime_behavior_to_test: Install, cold launch, relaunch, cache refresh, and update behavior.
runtime_source_path: pmp-app-current.html through the complete primary wrapper chain
smallest_test_or_receipt: Install once, record loaded URLs and digests, relaunch offline/online, change a cache key, and retain timestamped results.

decision_blocked_until: Static precedence proves intended order, not the final observed browser order.
missing_precedence_or_reachability_proof: The exact live frame ancestry and post-injection outermost order has not been observed.
preserved_claim: Exact live outermost Resident wrapper order has not been observed.
reopening_trigger: Any route, wrapper, injection timing, browser behavior, or serving origin changes.
required_environment_and_configuration: Local or deployed HTTPS runtime in a browser with same-origin access.
runtime_behavior_to_test: Actual frame URLs, load order, and injected-script order after manual open.
runtime_source_path: pmp-app-current.html → map v9 → Route Guardian v14 → wrapper v4 → wrapper v3 → home v6
smallest_test_or_receipt: Press Open Latest App, capture each frame URL and ordered script list after injection settles, and hash the receipt.

decision_blocked_until: Static storage calls strongly predict loss but do not prove the complete user-visible behavior.
missing_precedence_or_reachability_proof: The post-clear behavior has not been executed in a supported browser.
preserved_claim: Clearing browser storage loses saved Resident context.
reopening_trigger: Storage keys, backup path, browser/device, synchronization behavior, or test result changes.
required_environment_and_configuration: Supported browser/device with non-secret seeded Resident context.
runtime_behavior_to_test: Whether saved Resident context is lost after clearing site storage and reloading.
smallest_test_or_receipt: Seed identifiable test context, verify persistence, clear site storage, reload, and record before/after values and UI state.

decision_blocked_until: Repository verification workflows do not by themselves prove product-runtime test generation and execution.
missing_precedence_or_reachability_proof: No runtime-target manifest binds generated tests to the complete effective app chain and no current execution receipt covers it.
preserved_claim: Pre-code test design is architecture only; tests are not generated or executed.
reopening_trigger: Runtime graph, test manifest, test implementation, environment, or receipt changes.
required_environment_and_configuration: Authoritative main, exact runtime graph digest, and deterministic test environment.
runtime_behavior_to_test: Whether pre-code test designs became generated and executed tests against the current runtime.
runtime_source_path: Current runtime graph plus current executable test entry points
smallest_test_or_receipt: Generate a test manifest mapped to current runtime files, execute it, and retain pass/fail plus coverage digests.

decision_blocked_until: Static runtime source cannot establish that these dynamic test classes were required and executed.
missing_precedence_or_reachability_proof: No mutation, fuzz, property, or systematic fault-injection campaign is bound to the current graph.
preserved_claim: No mutation testing, fuzzing, property testing, or systematic fault injection is required or executed.
reopening_trigger: Runtime targets, tools, seeds, properties, fault model, thresholds, or results change.
required_environment_and_configuration: Authoritative main and isolated deterministic test environment.
runtime_behavior_to_test: Execution and results of each named test class.
runtime_source_path: Current runtime graph plus current executable test entry points
smallest_test_or_receipt: Run one bounded campaign for each named class against identified runtime targets and retain seeds, mutants/faults, outcomes, and digests.
